g.text: Asynchronous text input — one keystroke, two lifetimes (ADR-0033)
The field's value is owned LOCALLY from
here on. `draft` shadows the model, and the
value is recorded in `pending` so the model
echoing it back is recognised as ours and
not mistaken for an external push.
deliberately NOT cancelled when the query
changes: the buffer depends only on the
DOM. Cancelling it per keystroke meant a
the mutation counter it was built at
paint highlights, scroll to the first match
the keystroke (synchronous, must finish in microseconds)
no step in the lower lane occupies the main thread for more
than the frame budget without yielding
, and every one of them is abandoned
the moment the next character arrives.
